SRC-PHELO-043-R1's own unsupported_content note explicitly disclaims covering selection-bias subtypes or a confounder-vs-mediator distinction. The claimed corroborating library tag (CONCEPT-R4-SU-PH-12-HEALTHY-SCREENEE) is actually scoped to a different learner decision (lead-time bias / SU-PH-07) and states a different, allocation-based discriminator, not a third-variable-presence discriminator -- it contradicts rather than corroborates the proposal. Medically, healthy-screenee bias is itself commonly explained via an uncontrolled third variable (baseline health) correlated with exposure and outcome, so 'third variable present' does not cleanly rule it out -- unresolved second-key risk.
